targets.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.public_family_realizes
targets.header: theorem public_family_realizes : ∃ f : KernelDecisionSampler, (∀ t, Measurable (Function.uncurry (f t))) ∧ ∀ t h, (volume : Measure I).map (f t h) = decisionKernel t h

targets.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.public_causal_process
targets.header: theorem public_causal_process : (∀ t, Measurable (kernelCausalPolicy selectedSampler t)) ∧ (∀ t (u : ℕ → I) (y : ℕ → ℝ) (i : Fin t), kernelGeneratedActions selectedSampler t (fun j => u j) (fun j => y j) i = kernelGeneratedPrediction selectedSampler (i : ℕ) (u, y)) ∧ ∀ t (ω ω' : (ℕ → I) × (ℕ → ℝ)), (∀ i, i ≤ t → ω.1 i = ω'.1 i) → (∀ i, i < t → ω.2 i = ω'.2 i) → kernelGeneratedPrediction selectedSampler t ω = kernelGeneratedPrediction selectedSampler t ω'

targets.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.public_joint_law
targets.header: theorem public_joint_law (ν : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → ℝ)) (t : ℕ) : (kernelGameLaw ν).map (fun ω => (kernelGeneratedHistory selectedSampler t ω, kernelGeneratedPrediction selectedSampler t ω)) = (kernelGameLaw ν).map (kernelGeneratedHistory selectedSampler t) ⊗ₘ decisionKernel t

targets.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.public_conditional_law
targets.header: theorem public_conditional_law (ν : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → ℝ)) (t : ℕ) : condDistrib (kernelGeneratedPrediction selectedSampler t) (kernelGeneratedHistory selectedSampler t) (kernelGameLaw ν) =ᵐ[(kernelGameLaw ν).map (kernelGeneratedHistory selectedSampler t)] decisionKernel t

targets.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.actual_process_excess
targets.header: theorem actual_process_excess (T : ℕ) : expectedFixedRegret gameLaw target (fun t ω => (prediction t ω : ℝ)) T = (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, ∫ ω, ((prediction t ω : ℝ) - ∫ ω, target 0 ω ∂gameLaw)^2 ∂gameLaw) ∧ 0 ≤ expectedFixedRegret gameLaw target (fun t ω => (prediction t ω : ℝ)) T

targets.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.history_feedback_distribution
targets.header: theorem history_feedback_distribution : decisionKernel 1 (oneHistory 0 1) {1} = (1 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞) ∧ decisionKernel 1 (oneHistory 1 1) {1} = (3 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞) ∧ decisionKernel 1 (oneHistory 1 0) {1} = (1 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞)

targets.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.every_history_stochastic
targets.header: theorem every_history_stochastic (t : ℕ) (h : KernelDecisionHistory t) : (decisionKernel t h {1} = (1 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞) ∨ decisionKernel t h {1} = (3 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞)) ∧ 0 < decisionKernel t h {0} ∧ 0 < decisionKernel t h {1}

targets.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.actual_prediction_binary
targets.header: theorem actual_prediction_binary (t : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂gameLaw, prediction t ω = 0 ∨ prediction t ω = 1

targets.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.target_positive_variance
targets.header: theorem target_positive_variance (t : ℕ) : variance (target t) gameLaw = 1 / 4

targets.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.every_horizon_excess
targets.header: theorem every_horizon_excess (T : ℕ) : expectedFixedRegret gameLaw target (fun t ω => (prediction t ω : ℝ)) T = (T : ℝ) / 4

targets.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.zero_horizon_excess
targets.header: theorem zero_horizon_excess : expectedFixedRegret gameLaw target (fun t ω => (prediction t ω : ℝ)) 0 = 0

targets.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.positive_two_round_excess
targets.header: theorem positive_two_round_excess : expectedFixedRegret gameLaw target (fun t ω => (prediction t ω : ℝ)) 2 = 1 / 2 ∧ 0 < expectedFixedRegret gameLaw target (fun t ω => (prediction t ω : ℝ)) 2

selected_process: selectedSampler chooses K5 once before law/horizon
switch: 1 < last generated action + last observation; empty start uses low law
iid_observation_law: existing infinite Bernoulli(1/2) real stream, AE support only
